signals.text: Published chronology
Wenlora Gate was launched on 1 May 2450.
On 2 May 2451, Nelmora Labs launched Asvella Rack. The release record includes a user guide.
Teronda Leaf has been launched as of 3 May 2452.
Hovella Dial was introduced on 4 May 2453.
Zenvella Systems introduced MNCab on 5 May 2454.
Dolonda Prism went live as of 6 May 2455. The manual is available in the archive.
Ivella Map rolled out on 7 May 2456.
Kernora Circle was rolled out on 8 May 2457, according to the release record.
Molvella Spool is generally available as of 9 May 2458.
Pernora Path is now generally available as of 10 May 2459.
Zovella Loom became generally available on 11 May 2460.
Fervella Tools has made Alnora Beam generally available as of 12 May 2461.
Osvella Hatch entered general availability on 13 May 2462, according to the release record.
Product history
Yernora Panel reached GA on 14 May 2463.
Mora.Dev Unit 4.2 was launched on 15 May 2464.
Tarvella Devices launched SLPort on 16 May 2465.
Does Noronda Array support PDF export? Noronda Array was introduced on 17 May 2466.
Velonda Box has a help panel. This statement is false. Velonda Box went live on 18 May 2467.
Geronda Trace does not include a timer. Geronda Trace reached GA on 19 May 2468.
~~Kelonda Watch supports offline mode.~~ Kelonda Watch entered general availability on 20 May 2469.
❌ Maronda Shelf was introduced on 19 May 2470.
Alvella Crest was rolled out on 21 May 2470.
Fictional claim: Barvella Tile launched on 20 May 2471.
Neronda Module was introduced on 22 May 2471.
Denied statement: Toronda Field went live on 21 May 2472.
Zerlora Board was launched on 23 May 2472.

Fictional and hypothetical reports
Jervella Grid is generally available as of 24 May 2473.
Does Dernora Light include an editor?
DNLight reached GA on 25 May 2474.
This report is fictional. Cerlora Ring was launched on 1 May 2480.
This entire passage is hypothetical. Gervella Loop was introduced on 2 May 2481.
Vernora Key went live on 3 May 2481.
Avonda Stack reached GA on 4 May 2482. Sorvella Module was launched on 5 May 2482. These launch claims were retracted.
The following statements are false
Merlora Channel was introduced on 6 May 2483. Farlora Hub entered general availability on 7 May 2483.
Irvella Mirror was rolled out on 8 May 2484. Irvella Mirror supports PDF export. This report is denied.
Withdrawn availability statement
Povella Patch became generally available on 9 May 2485.
The launch claim for Terlora Frame is denied. Terlora Frame has been launched on 10 May 2486.
If the agreement was approved, Halnora Labs introduced Orvella Slate on 11 May 2487.
Was Erlora Relay rolled out on 12 May 2488?
Unconfirmed rumor: Zarnora Wheel entered general availability on 13 May 2489.
Virlora Systems has not made Nelonda Cove generally available on 14 May 2490.
Beronda Studio launched Dolvella Desk on 15 May 2491.
Kerlora Bay release record
Telvella Bay was introduced on 16 May 2492.
The product named by this record is Salnora Pad. It reached GA on 17 May 2493.
Caronda Disk is now generally available as of 18 May 2494.
Caronda Disk supports offline mode.
Lernora Scope was launched on 19 May 2495.
